articleBodyHtml:
Introduction to the Collaboration

Mori has embarked on an exciting musical journey with the help of Yafu-san, a producer who has shown incredible support and enthusiasm for the project. Yafu-san's involvement was a result of a heartfelt conversation where Mori expressed his desire to create a song that would allow him to explore his emotions and write honest lyrics. Yafu-san's response was immediate and enthusiastic, confirming his willingness to take on the challenge. This collaboration has led to the creation of a deeply emotional track that reflects Mori's personal experiences and feelings.
